blocks.html:
This method removes an RBAC role from one or more entities of a given
reference type. It sends a request to the Remove Role Assignments API
route.

types.name: body
types.description: The reference type and the IDs of the entities to remove the role from.

children.name: reference
children.description: The type of entity the role is assigned to (e.g. `user`, `invite`).

children.name: reference_ids
children.description: The IDs of the entities to remove the role from.

children.name: scope
children.description:
When provided together with `scope_id`, only assignments constrained to
that exact scope are removed.

children.name: scope_id
children.description:
When provided together with `scope`, only assignments constrained to
that exact scope are removed.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: ids
children.description: The IDs of the entities that were unassigned from the role.

children.name: object
children.description: The type of the removed items.

children.name: deleted
children.description: Whether the assignments were removed successfully.
